book.name: Yoan
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Yoan byex o

content: Yesu luk is vex wei Samaria yo ti
De Parisiyeiw ngo qayeeng bei Yesu lipek xomaxoneing me wong xel wo betiyeing ngenong ghanaw Yoan.
Ekom Yesu venaxow se lipek xel, qe inyon e xe xel betiyeing.
Yesu woulek bei xel Parisi ngo tine om la veil Yudia de lox me la Galili no.
Dom moxo tupwou sakwaing tiwei la senghoing eivek Samaria nei.
Om moxo la eivek beyeeng nayak ti lei Sikar eivek tembuing danghei wei Samaria yo. Beyeeng tiyon toundei paviy tembuing wei Yakop wong wou neu Yosep o.
Yakop xe leiveeng memiing ti toundei inyei, de Yesu nima en ingwei lam sakwaing anding o, om la dei paviy leiveeng memiing on. Inyon nambei seivma evlek o.
Gyeik Samaria vex ti lam en embei nam a puw memiing eno Yesu neil wou vexo, “Tyek wang bong memiing me a num?”
Moxo xe xel betiyeing la eivek beyeeng nayak en xel embei na bou lul yaeing.
Samaria vex neil wou e bei, “Wa Yuda ti de a Samaria vex ti. Nambei nya wang teling wou ay en numeing?” En Yudayeiw me Samariayeiw se mindei is ama.
Yesu lewexe wou vexo, “Wangwei wang boulek lul xeilala wei Anutu embei bong o me eti ingwei teling wang en numeing, on wa teling wou e me embong memiing wei mapieing o wou wang.”
Vex neil wou bei, “Teiv, deng me yis wei wambei puw memiing nangya eno ma de leiveeng memiing ne la ghembi. Tyek wa qou memiing mapieing tiyon nanghei inya?
Beip wang ghanaw xe bund Yakop, moxo wong leiveeng memiing tine wou xa de e venaxow is neuyeiw me manghaxo me sipsip is lul dalus mi num memiing tine?”
Yesu lewexe, “Xomaxoneing sapa wei mi num memiing tine eno tyek kwend a tip no,
ekom xelti embei num memiing wei ambei bong wou e ne tyek kwa se tip. De memiing wei ambei bong wou e eno tyek na mi puw lulaxeiv eivek e me bong mapieing luta luta wou e.”
De vex neil wou e bei, “Teiv, wang bong memiing tiyon wou ay en kandek a kwang se tip no de a se mi nox me noum inye en puweing memiing.”
Moxo neil wou vexo bei, “La, taxe leyam de muw xouing loum.”
Vexo neil elox bei, “A leyang ma yo.” Yesu neil wou e, “Wang neil neing, gyeik ingwei wang neimbei wa leyam ma yo.
En nambei wa leyam lim, de moux tiwei wang toundei is ne inye se wa leyam. Qayeeng vati wei wang neil on zonghek ayang.”
De vexo neil wou e bei, “Teiv, a xei bei inye wa poropet ti.
Xa bumiyeiw mi wong lalo lek lukendu tine, ekom xam Yudayeiw eno xam ghe mi neimbei beyeeng wei xomaxoneing a mi bong lalo eno eivek Yerusalem.”
Yesu neil teyei wou e bei, “Vex, wang bongis ay, bouk ti tyek nam eno tyek xam seng bong lalo wou Mang lek lukendu tine o eivek Yerusalem.
Xam Samariayeiw ghe mi wong lalo wou vati wei xam seng woulek o, de xa Yudayeiw a mi wong lalo wou vati wei xa woulek o, en vineing wei qou xa lam veil nilul eno lam wou xa Yuda.

Ekom bouk ti tyek nam, me gweimbeeng ne eno lam woy om gyeik xel embei bong lalo zonghek ond xel bong lalo wou Mang eivek Laweeng me zonghek, en Mang lalei vind xel ambei nyon bei xel a mi bong lalo wou e.
Anutu yon laweeng, om xel wei mi wong lalo wou e eno xel a mi bong lalo eivek Laweeng me eivek zonghek.”
De vexo neil embei, “A woulek bei Mesia tiwei xel mi taxe e bei Kilisi eno tyek nam. Om gyeik ingwei moxo embei nam, eno tyek na neil lul dalusateiv teyei wou xey.”
Woyom Yesu neilteyei wou e bei, “A tambiy tiyon, ingwei di luk is wang ne eno inye ay.”
Xel betiyeing loumelam wou Yesu
Woyom ka e xe xel betiyeing loum eno xel etek en xel yei ingwei di luk is vex ti yo. Ekom xelti se teling, “Wa bei qou vati?” o “Nambei nya wang di luk is vex on?”
Woyom vexo ghanaw e xe memiing dengmuing toundei de lox me la beyeeng me neil wou xomaxoneing dalus nambei nye,
“Xam lam wei tambiy tiwei neil wou ay en lul dalus wei a mi wong takwei yo. Beip inyei Kilisi?”
Om xel lam veil beyeeng nayak on me la yei e.
Dekakom e xe xel betiyeing neil wou e bei, “Putoung, wa lulul ne.”
Ekom moxo neil wou xel, “A xe yaeing wei yaing eno xam seng woulek o.”
Woyom e xe xel betiyeing di neil wouma bei, “Beip xel valu qou lul yaeing me lam wou e?”
Yesu neil wou xel, “A xe lul yaeing eno nambei nye, a bei betiwou tambiy tiwei wong a lam eno lalei me na bong e xe xuk e na pyap lek.
Beip xam seng mi neimbei, ‘Dentouk qes vey di yeip zeyi bouk wei qekuwou lulul yaeing o?’ A neil wou xam, xam ghe gweina xuk danghei danghei nei! Lulul wo neing woy teyei lek qoueing.

Me gweimbeeng tambiy wei mi qekuwou lulul yaeing eno qou e xe xouveing me di qeku lul yaeing wei deing mapieing luta luta yo, om tambiy wei vuw lul o me tambiy wei wong xuk lek qoueing lulul neing o, eno luw xouing bo xeindlala.
Inye xel neil, ‘Tambiy nge vuw lulul eivek xuk de nge qekuwou lulul neing’ eno qayeeng ne zonghek.
A wong xam ghe la qekuwou lulul yaeing wei xam seng wo xuk lek o. Qe xel valu wong pok ngandoung lek, de xam ghe la qou vineing lek pok wei xel o.”
Xel Samaria ngenong wongis
Xel Samaria ngenong wei beyeeng nayak tiyon eno wongis Yesu, en qayeeng wei vex on neil teyei yo, “Moxo neil wou ay en lulul dalus wei a wong takwei yo.”
Om gyeik ingwei Samariayeiw lam wou moxo eno xel neil wou bei e toumendei is xel, om moxo toundei bouk yayuw is xel.
En nambei Yesu xe qayeeng wei neil, eno moux alis vex ngenong wongis.
Xel neil wou vex on, “Xa se wongis en nambei vati wei wang neil o, qe gweimbeeng xa maxow a ngo me na woulek bei inye neing ayang, tambiy tine qou xey a loum veil nilul wei tembuing sapa yo.”
Yesu wong beyeiv neu moux wo nimzalek
Ka bouk yuw on la veil eno Yesu la Galili.
Yesu venaxow neil qayeeng tine, xel se mi wevek poropet ti xeinghembi eivek emaxow beeng qes.
Om gyeik ingwei moxo la tyip Galili, eno Galiliyeiw wo xeindlala en e. En xel yei lul wei wong eivek Yerusalem gyeik mata wei Pasova yo, en xel la toundei inyei is.
Yesu lox me la beyeeng Kana eivek Galili no, wei nanghei inyon eno moxo pekwi memiing wo wain. De nanghei inyei eno king xe beyeiv ti neu moux vanei wong me e di yeip anghei Kapenaom.
Woyom tambiy tiyon ngo bei Yesu la veil Yudia me la toundei Galili, eno moxo la wou e me tay wou Yesu bei e nam bong e neu moux bo nimzalek, en neu e bim amey.
Yesu neil wou e, “Wangwei xam ne seng gwei dee wei lulvako yo ond xam seng mi wongis.”
King xe beyeiv neil wou e, “Teiv, wang nam axone daing enok a neung amey.”
Yesu neil elox wou e bei, “Wang nox en neum tyek na toumendei mapieing.” De moux tiyon wongis qayeeng wei Yesu neil o me la.
Ka moxo di la wou sakwaing, e xe xel xukxe lam pelong e me neil wou bei, neum toundei mapieing.
Woyom moxo teling xel en seivma wei neu wo nimzalek, eno xel neil wou e, “Gying ma veil e vezeiveeng soukeing wei seivma ti yo.”
Woyom ma woulek bei lek seivma kayon eno Yesu neil wou e, “Neum tyek na toumendei mapieing.” Om moxo is nipapu dalus wei e beeng eno wongis.
Inye dee wei lulvako luyuw wei Yesu wong gyeik e la veil Yudia me la toundei Galili yo.
